keep.hopealive # ACTUAL POWER RANKINGS

1. Fuggles
2. Jessica
3. Jakey

5. Cameron

Jakey/Drew are a great UTR duo. No one has clocked how close they are or the power/influence they have in the game.
Cameron was well-connected enough with the outsiders to save himself last Tribal via idol, is now in a spot to where he’s able to make a comeback.
Ore, despite accidentally letting his own plan slip, is still in a great position, well-protected across his never-ending army of allies.
David coming back to the game opens things up. He re-assumes his spot of being at the top of Kanto before being idoled out, and already has a reason to be against public enemies #1 and #2.
Robynn has been left out of a SECOND idol-out blindside. Her trust was placed in the wrong people, but I predict she will re-position herself nicely once merge is officially on.
Woofley has now made up with her nemesis Jakey. She needs to be on the same page with these people now that Kebab wasn’t able to come back this round.
Luis/Wyatt might be one of the most chaotic duos Fiovivor has ever seen. They have torn this game apart, but their low-positions seem to be the natural consequence of their own actions. Wyatt is likely cooked here, but can absolutely save himself if need be.
Cooper is this low also due to being a chaos player, however unlike Luis/Wyatt he has no clear loyalties to anyone. He’s been very wishy-washy.
Nub is on the bottom on his side of the game. If anyone on his side is to be offered up as sacrifice or a casualty of another blindside, it’d be him. He has the Legacy Advantage, but I don’t know if he gets to the de-merge to actually use it.
Nicholas/Bazz are essentially dead in the water. Nicholas is barely hanging afloat via his connections to Fuggles and Wyatt, and Bazz is barely hanging afloat due to his “connections” to Drew/Jakey.
